added_lines: . annual mass for the deceased members of kilclief ben dearg gac will be held in the clubrooms on wednesday 11th november 2026 at 7.30pm. kilclief cemetery many of you will be aware of the problem we have with rock, which is a lot more extensive that we first hoped. we will dig out 2 rows of graves each year and fill them with soil so that the digging will be so much easier when they are required. we spent £4,000 during the summer and as a result the finance committee agreed with me that to recoup this money being spent we are keeping the price of graves for parishioners (those who live within the parish boundaries or those who live outside the parish boundaries that contribute via weekly envelope or standing order) at £300 but increasing the price for those living outside the parish to £1,000 in line with many of our neighbouring parishes. thank you for your continued support. fr aidan in addition to the masses offered during the month of november for our deceased relatives and friends, special masses will be celebrated for all parishioners who have died in the past year (those residing in our parish at the time of death, or those interred in our parish cemeteries). a candle will be lit for each person by a family representative. an additional candle will be lit for family and friends from outside our parish who have died. please contact the parish office to ensure your loved ones name is included on the intentions list for these masses. st patrick’s, saul – friday 13th november at 7pm stella maris, strangford – monday 16th november at 7.30pm strangford and district men’s shed will hold their annual general meeting at glebe house on monday 2nd november at 8pm. the meeting is open to all men over 18 who may like to find out what we do at the men’s shed. a cuppa will be served and hopefully some cookies!

with offices in belfast, derry and enniskillen, we p rovide a range of free support services, such as crisis intervention, counselling, and befriending, to individuals and families affected by suicidal thoughts, emotional distress, mental health difficulties, and bereavement.

we would particularly like to bring your attention to our weekend crisis hopeline, a regional overnight telephone service available friday and sunday nights, to anyone across northern ireland experiencing emotional distress, suicidal thoughts, or a mental health crisis.

the weekend crisis hopeline provides a confidential, non-judgemental space to talk with a trained crisis practitioner when someone is in distress, needs support or simply wants someone to talk to during a difficult time outside of working hours.
